scope: execution only: the searches, proposer, budget, tasks, measures, hypotheses, and analyses are unchanged
observation: The run used run_search_deep.run_all, whose loop records a unit's row only while no unit has raised an exception outside ReplTimeout; after such an exception the executor keeps running the queued units but records none of them. This happened at 10:22 local time, when the machine went to sleep with 1984 unit rows recorded, and again at the first units completed after a resume at 12:48; neither exception was printed, because it surfaces only once the whole queue has run. The two isolated units checked afterwards (FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.realize_foldr_sup, both searches) ran normally.
change: run_search_wide.py runs the units with its own loop: an exception raised by a unit becomes an error row (the unit's identity, the exception's type and message), which a later resume runs again, and no exception can stop the recording; a retried unit keeps its last row; the summary also counts error rows per search. The unit itself is still run_search_deep.run_unit, unchanged.

resultsSeenBeforeAmendment.note: the runner's progress log prints each unit's expansion count and whether it found a proof, and its tail was read while diagnosing; operational counts were computed over the recorded rows (228 rows not constructed, none abandoned, no REPL timeouts or restarts); no summary, fraction, or hypothesis was computed
